prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='FT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA is the trend champion with perfect correlation (1.0) but poor seasonality capture (-0.19). FT_rf leads seasonality (0.37) while FT_catboost achieves lowest RMSE (61.15) despite inverted trend correlation. High disagreement (rmse_spread=32.3) and unstable rankings (Kendall=0.18) with concept drift detected suggest robust median/trimmed_mean combinations over weighted stacking.
